rules_version: ALTA General Rules Adult Leagues, Fall 2026 (last revised Spring 2026)

_notes.lines: Copied from data/alta_leagues.json for the team's league. Change league to reuse for another ALTA team.
_notes.pair_move_limit: Rule III.E: a pair may move up or down only one line from the last legal line played together.
_notes.individual_move_limit: Rule III.E: a player without her partner may move up or down two lines from her last legal line.
_notes.max_roster_addons: Rule I.G.5: after schedules are posted, a maximum of six players may be added.
_notes.default_minutes: Glossary, DEFAULT: a line is defaulted if a pair is not courtside 20 minutes after its scheduled start.
_notes.warmup_minutes: Rule IV.G: warm-up is limited to 10 minutes.
_notes.line_duration_hours: Captain's note: a line can take 1 to 3 hours. Used for time-limit risk checks, not an ALTA rule.
_notes.playoffs: Out of scope for the MVP. Regular season only (movement and sandbagging rules apply only in the regular season).
_notes.level_flight: Synthetic team at AA-3, the top flight of the highest level. Real teams read like AA-3 or A-5 (see data/alta_leagues.json levels). Used for the sub add-on rule R8.
